The lens has 'TAMRON' and '24-70mm' visible. A Canon battery and charger are in front, with 'Canon' visible on both.
Photo 1 shows the top right of the camera, including the mode dial, MENU, INFO, RATE, and other buttons. The camera body has 'Canon' branding. The lens is attached, and the camera is on bubble wrap.

Photo 2 is similar to photo 1, showing the top right of the camera with the same buttons and branding. The camera body is black, and the lens is attached. The background includes a book with 'HRT FILM' visible.
No model number is visible on the camera body in any photo. The lens has 'TAMRON' and '24-70mm' visible, but no Canon lens model is readable.
The camera appears to be a DSLR with a mirrorless sensor, as indicated by the 'AF-ON' and 'AF-C' labels on the screen. The shutter count is not visible in any photo.
The camera is not powered on; the screen is off in all photos.
